nodes.description: external pure function compute(uint256 x) returns uint256; evaluates the Pedersen hash column polynomial using Horner's method inside an inline assembly block and returns result % PRIME.
uint256 input parameter x of compute; the evaluation point repeatedly multiplied into the running Horner accumulator via mulmod(..., x, PRIME).
uint256 constant 0x800000000000011000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 declared inside compute and used as the third operand of every mulmod reduction.
uint256 accumulator holding the Horner evaluation result; initialized from the highest coefficient and rewritten block-by-block in assembly, then returned modulo PRIME.
Inline assembly block performing unchecked modular arithmetic via chains of add()/mulmod(...,x,PRIME) Horner iterations on raw 256-bit words; low-level opcodes bypass Solidity's arithmetic checks.

edges.reason: Parameter x is the sole input consumed by compute and drives the polynomial evaluation.
The local accumulator result is returned from compute as result % PRIME.
compute unconditionally transfers execution into the inline assembly block that performs the Horner evaluation.
x is fed as the multiplicand of every mulmod step inside the assembly Horner loop.
PRIME is used as the modulus argument of every mulmod call inside the assembly block.
result is read and reassigned on each of the seven-iteration Horner batches inside the assembly block.
The final assembly accumulator value is written back to the local variable result.

normalization_plan.reason: x is a parameter whose only role is to be consumed by compute, so it can be normalized into the compute function node.
PRIME is a local constant used exclusively as the mulmod modulus inside the inline assembly Horner block and can be merged into that unsafe_operation node.
result is a local accumulator that is the return value of compute and can be normalized into the compute function node.
